review_method: static source review and stdlib-only synthetic self-tests

findings.issue: Duplicate JSON object keys are silently overwritten within a receipt
findings.mechanism: Ordinary JSON parsing retains the final value for a repeated split, metric, coverage or status key. The later cross-file duplicate check cannot observe those conflicting earlier values.
findings.smallest_correction: Reject repeated object keys during JSON parsing; retain the existing cross-file merge behavior.
findings.current_release_receipt_impact: No actual contradictory receipt was examined; this is a concrete accepted-input parser gap.

findings.issue: ZIP expansion and nested-archive blocking depend on filename suffix
findings.mechanism: A ZIP container using another suffix is decoded as compressed bytes without examining member text. The same applies to a nested ZIP member whose filename has another suffix.
findings.smallest_correction: Identify supported ZIP containers from their bytes, regardless of filename, and block nested containers from their bytes.
findings.current_release_receipt_impact: No renamed archive was examined in the actual tree; this is a concrete scanner coverage gap.

passed_source_checks: Expected-values bytes are SHA-256 pinned before comparison
Tolerance is fixed to 1e-6 and hash tolerance is exact
Only COMPLETE split stages can provide metric values
Coverage requires integer benchmark and pair counts of 145 and 13023
Boolean and nonfinite metric values are rejected
Missing files, dataless files and incomplete stages cannot produce PASS
Conflicting split receipts across input files produce FAIL
Default full-comparison package model and ZIP paths are compared using exact byte hashes
Scrub match output contains locations and counts without matched content
Symlinks, known unsupported archives and unavailable content prevent a scrub PASS
corrections: Every JSON object level rejects duplicate decoded keys without exposing key contents.
Top-level ZIP containers are identified from bytes even when renamed or prefixed; member text is scanned.
Nested supported or known unsupported archive/compression containers are blocked based on bytes or suffix.
Known unsupported archive/compression signatures prevent a scrub PASS.

scope_limits: The comparator checks receipt values and package bytes; it does not independently prove execution origin or individual score-row population.
The scrubber scans plain decoded text and ZIP members; unsupported recognized containers block completion. Content without a recognizable format signature is not a universal format decoder.
No public-data scan, scientific calculation or installation was performed.

staged_comparison.default: both splits and all exact package hashes
